name: rpi-stack
description: Flexible research, planning, implementation, audit, and code review skills for coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Flexible research, plan, implement, audit, and code review skills.
interface.longDescription: RPI Stack provides six coding skills that can be used individually or together. Agents select phases by uncertainty and risk, ground decisions in current sources, respect task authorization, and verify changes proportionately. Optional profiles cover backend, web frontend, Flutter, and scripts.
defaultPrompt: Use rpi to implement this feature.
Use research before modifying this architecture.
Use code-review to review my git diff.
